subject: Business Models
title: Algorithmic Matching
description: A fast breakdown of Algorithmic Matching for builders.

hook.text: You search 'plumber near me' on Thumbtack. An algorithm ranks 200 plumbers in milliseconds.

buildup.text: Algorithmic matching uses data—ratings, proximity, price, response time—to predict the best fit.

discovery.text: Better matching increases satisfaction. Uber's algorithm considers driver location, trip route, and car type.

twist.text: Algorithms can embed bias. Studies show ride-sharing algorithms pick up Black passengers less frequently.

climax.text: Matching quality determines marketplace success. A poor match wastes both seller and buyer time.

punchline.text: 200 plumbers in milliseconds. The algorithm is the product.

quiz.question: What data does Uber's matching algorithm consider?
